item.title: Tellus Magnetic — Total Magnetic Intensity (residual) source files
item.subtitle: Geology and Geophysics / GSNI, Tellus
item.description: Residual total magnetic intensity (TMI) from the GSNI Tellus airborne survey — variations in the Earth's magnetic field caused by buried magnetic minerals (chiefly magnetite). High-magnetic anomalies trace mafic/ultramafic intrusions, basaltic flows, and iron-bearing sedimentary basins; magnetic lows mark sedimentary basins and demagnetised alteration zones. 35m grid spacing, ±3σ rainbow ramp.

references.label: OSNI Open Data — Tellus Magnetic Grids
